queries: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALP) AS avg_ALP, AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_HCT FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN l.`U-PRO` = '-' AND l.RA = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY (AVG(l.HCT) IS NULL) ASC, AVG(l.HCT) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALP) AS avg_ALP, AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_HCT FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS qualifying WHERE qualifying.ID = p.ID AND qualifying.`U-PRO` = '-' AND qualifying.RA = '-') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY AVG(l.HCT) IS NULL, AVG(l.HCT) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALP) AS avg_ALP, AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_HCT FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS q WHERE q.ID = p.ID AND q.`U-PRO` = '-' AND q.RA = '-') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY avg_HCT IS NULL, avg_HCT DESC LIMIT 10;
